command_line:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 2) stop("Expected expression and metadata paths")
expr_path <- args[[1]]
meta_path <- args[[2]]

expr <- read.csv(expr_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))
meta <- read.csv(meta_path, header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE,
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = c("", "NA"))

if (ncol(expr) < 2L) stop("Expression matrix must have gene IDs plus sample columns")
if (!("projid" %in% names(meta))) stop("Metadata must contain projid")
if (any(is.na(names(expr)[-1])) || any(names(expr)[-1] == "")) stop("Blank expression sample ID")
if (any(is.na(meta$projid)) || any(meta$projid == "")) stop("Blank metadata projid")

gene_ids <- as.character(expr[[1L]])
sample_ids <- as.character(names(expr)[-1L])
meta_ids <- as.character(meta$projid)

if (anyDuplicated(gene_ids)) stop("Duplicate gene identifiers are not resolved")
if (!setequal(unique(sample_ids), unique(meta_ids))) {
  stop("Expression and metadata primary ID sets do not match")
}
if (!setequal(sample_ids, meta_ids)) {
  stop("Expression and metadata multiplicities do not match")
}

expr_dup_ids <- sort(names(which(table(sample_ids) > 1L)))
meta_dup_ids <- sort(names(which(table(meta_ids) > 1L)))
if (!setequal(expr_dup_ids, meta_dup_ids)) stop("Repeated-ID groups do not match")

stable_fields <- setdiff(names(meta), "projid")
metadata_conflict <- setNames(logical(length(meta_dup_ids)), meta_dup_ids)
if (length(meta_dup_ids) > 0L && length(stable_fields) > 0L) {
  for (id in meta_dup_ids) {
    block <- meta[meta$projid == id, stable_fields, drop = FALSE]
    metadata_conflict[[id]] <- any(vapply(block, function(v) {
      length(unique(v[!is.na(v)])) > 1L
    }, logical(1)))
  }
}

# Repeated primary IDs have no explicit secondary identity in the supplied
# metadata. Treat every such group as an unresolved identity collision and
# exclude every occurrence from a subject/sample-level PCA.
keep_sample <- !(sample_ids %in% expr_dup_ids)
fitted_sample_ids <- sample_ids[keep_sample]
if (length(fitted_sample_ids) < 2L) stop("No resolved samples remain")

numeric_part <- expr[, -1L, drop = FALSE]
X_gene_by_sample <- as.matrix(numeric_part)
suppressWarnings(storage.mode(X_gene_by_sample) <- "numeric")
if (any(!is.finite(X_gene_by_sample))) stop("Expression matrix contains non-finite values")
if (any(X_gene_by_sample < 0)) stop("Expression matrix contains negative values")

X <- t(X_gene_by_sample[, keep_sample, drop = FALSE])
rownames(X) <- fitted_sample_ids
colnames(X) <- gene_ids

# Requested transform: log10(expression + pseudocount 1), after identity
# resolution and before PCA.
pseudocount <- 1
X <- log10(X + pseudocount)
if (any(!is.finite(X))) stop("Transformed matrix contains non-finite values")

feature_variance <- apply(X, 2L, var)
keep_feature <- is.finite(feature_variance) & feature_variance > 0
if (!any(keep_feature)) stop("No positive-variance genes remain after transform")
X <- X[, keep_feature, drop = FALSE]

requested_components <- 100L
if (nrow(X) <= requested_components) stop("Fewer than 101 resolved samples; cannot fit 100 components")

# Classical PCA: observations are rows, genes are columns; center features,
# do not scale them. The denominator is total variance over the full retained
# feature space, not only the first 100 components.
fit <- prcomp(X, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE, rank. = requested_components)
n_fitted_components <- length(fit$sdev)
if (n_fitted_components != requested_components) stop("PCA did not produce 100 components")
centered <- sweep(X, 2L, fit$center, "-")
total_variance <- sum(centered^2) / (nrow(X) - 1L)
eigenvalues <- fit$sdev^2
explained_ratio <- eigenvalues / total_variance
explained_percent <- 100 * explained_ratio

variance_out <- data.frame(
  component = seq_len(n_fitted_components),
  eigenvalue = eigenvalues,
  explained_variance_ratio = explained_ratio,
  explained_variance_percent = explained_percent,
  cumulative_explained_variance_percent = 100 * cumsum(explained_ratio)
)
write.table(variance_out, file = "pca_variance.tsv", sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, na = "NA")

summary_metric <- c(
  "analysis_method",
  "matrix_orientation",
  "raw_expression_sample_columns",
  "raw_expression_unique_sample_ids",
  "metadata_rows",
  "metadata_unique_projids",
  "repeated_primary_id_groups",
  "excluded_unresolved_sample_columns",
  "fitted_resolved_samples",
  "raw_gene_rows",
  "retained_positive_variance_genes",
  "removed_zero_variance_genes",
  "transform",
  "pseudocount",
  "centering",
  "scaling",
  "requested_components",
  "fitted_components",
  "total_variance_denominator",
  "pc1_explained_variance_ratio",
  "pc1_explained_variance_percent"
)
summary_value <- c(
  "classical PCA via R prcomp",
  "samples as rows; genes as columns",
  as.character(length(sample_ids)),
  as.character(length(unique(sample_ids))),
  as.character(nrow(meta)),
  as.character(length(unique(meta_ids))),
  as.character(length(expr_dup_ids)),
  as.character(sum(!keep_sample)),
  as.character(nrow(X)),
  as.character(length(gene_ids)),
  as.character(ncol(X)),
  as.character(length(gene_ids) - ncol(X)),
  "log10(x + 1)",
  as.character(pseudocount),
  "feature-centered",
  "unscaled",
  as.character(requested_components),
  as.character(n_fitted_components),
  "sum of variances over all retained genes",
  sprintf("%.17g", explained_ratio[[1L]]),
  sprintf("%.17g", explained_percent[[1L]])
)
summary_out <- data.frame(metric = summary_metric, value = summary_value,
                          stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
write.table(summary_out, file = "pca_summary.tsv", sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, na = "NA")

if (length(expr_dup_ids) > 0L) {
  audit <- meta[meta$projid %in% expr_dup_ids, , drop = FALSE]
  audit$metadata_conflict_on_stable_field <- unname(metadata_conflict[as.character(audit$projid)])
  audit$identity_status <- "unresolved collision; excluded"
  audit$identity_reason <- "repeated primary projid without explicit secondary identity"
} else {
  audit <- data.frame(
    projid = character(0),
    metadata_conflict_on_stable_field = logical(0),
    identity_status = character(0),
    identity_reason = character(0),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
write.table(audit, file = "identity_audit.tsv", sep = "\t",
            row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, na = "NA")
